question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

PMRO NKTQ LIVS ? HEZW
solution:
The position and positional value of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b0ef7bac774935a44da6f4097f1538b554d0d2765a00145f123d8f8a5728860.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc8870269c6d8e3c00153990f890ffe258f11a4963b3878cac57a77e7f29ffe4.png] 

Thus, **'JGXU' **will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer ***'Option 4'.***
